games.title: Arena Shooter
games.tag: online multiplayer · first person · up to 8
games.desc: Online first-person shooter for up to eight players, with three hand-authored maps: Breakwater Harbor, a 96 × 96 m cargo terminal with a warehouse flank, tactical container lanes, gantry cranes and a moored ship; Freight Yard, a compact rail yard; and Trench City, a fought-over European square. Choose free for all, 4v4 team deathmatch or king of the hill. Seven weapons have individual sight animations and optical zoom; ADS and grounded crouching improve accuracy, while movement, jumping and sustained fire widen spread. Start with a weaker sidearm and earn stronger guns from jump-to-hit loot blocks. Walk at 4 m/s, sprint, crouch silently and keep the original jump reach. Fitted weapon grips, sun and shadows, moving clouds, weather, visible bullet paths, spatial sound and gamepad support. WASD + mouse, Space jump, RMB aim, R reload, Shift sprint, C crouch, Q shield, E melee, Tab scoreboard and F fullscreen.

versions.note: grounded environments: local contact shading at cover bases, warehouse corners and raised roof junctions across all three maps; existing sun, weather and gameplay preserved
first material polish: view-dependent metal and paint highlights, matte concrete, dry-weather sky reflection on harbor water, consistent crane paint and linear-light texture filtering
Breakwater Harbor: a hand-authored 96 × 96 m tactical port for eight players, with a moored ship, cranes, container routes, proper large-map collision and 4 m/s walking

aim, settle, fire: individual weapon zoom and sight animations, ADS plus crouch accuracy, movement penalties, recovering spread, a weaker starter sidearm and slower ground movement with preserved jumps
hands on the weapon: per-gun posed gloves and fingers, textured sleeves, and arm IK that keeps other players holding their weapons while aiming and crouching
skies and weather: directional sun, cast shadows, drifting clouds, sheltered rain, fading smoke and wet-surface sky reflections
boots: a footstep on every plant of the walk animation, a heavier and louder one at a sprint, silence while crouched at any speed, all panned and delayed by distance like the guns

the realism pass: rounds at real muzzle velocity stopped by the first thing on their path, tracers and impacts by material from shot events, layered gunshots panned and delayed by distance, the supersonic crack of a near miss
modes: free for all to 20 frags, team deathmatch to 30 with blue and red, king of the hill to 60 on the dock and the plinth; rounds end and restart after a 10 s pause

games.title: Fire Racer
games.desc: Arcade racing through a gothic castle bailey — a 920 m circuit with a main straight, a long sweeper, a fountain chicane and a hairpin. WASD to drive, Space for the handbrake to break traction and drift, Shift to spend one of three boost charges. Practice alone, or open a lobby and race other people on an authoritative server.

versions.note: castle circuit, drift + boost, online lobbies
archived — the first build, before the castle circuit

games.title: Four Kings
games.tag: online, turn based, 2-4 players, 15 s turns
games.desc: Four-corner chess on a 10x10 board: king, queen, two rooks, two bishops, a knight and seven pawns per corner, plus two new legends. The Joker teleports between mirror tiles, is placed anywhere every fifth turn, and captures on exactly one tile, its front-left. The Hero sleeps in the corner until it trades places with one of your pawns and wakes as a rook-plus-knight. Pawns march forward or left and capture on three diagonals, so a corner formation is never a wall. One action per 15-second turn, three timeouts and you are out, last king standing wins. Click a piece, click a highlighted target; Esc clears. Swap your legend and epic cards within their class before the game starts.

versions.note: first build: within-class card swap, 15 s turns

games.title: what is this?
games.tag: local diagnostic · browser + hardware · optional upload
games.desc: A playful, staged answer to a practical question: what kind of machine and browser is this? Runs fixed wasm CPU and timing kernels, records floating-point and feature fingerprints, and keeps going when a probe is unavailable. The complete JSON report can stay on your device; sending it to the Ember server is a separate, explicit choice.

versions.note: nine-stage diagnostic suite, now with a Julibrot fast-slide test; report submission remains optional
